Anonymous GET succeeded; labels were District, Tehsil, Village. Public count endpoints also succeeded.

Anonymous form POST level=2&codes=175 succeeded; Soraon was returned as native tehsil code 00888.

Anonymous form POST gisLevels=09,175,00888,218785 returned xmin=0.0, ymin=0.0, xmax=0.0, ymax=0.0 and no parcel geometry. Plot-at-XY and plot-number routes were not pursued after the official village response said hasData=false.

No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, Cloudflare defeat, private token, or TLS exception used.
No sample GeoJSON was written because the official target village response had hasData=false and the map extent was zero; no safe native parcel feature with usable geometry and identity was returned.
All raw HTML, JavaScript, level responses, and request evidence remain under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/phaphamau/.
Packet completion is not source integration or adapter admission.
uncertainty: The viewer establishes an official state custodian and a target village code, but not parcel coverage for the exact WUP point or citywide coverage.
Phaphamau is represented as a revenue village in the public hierarchy; the WUP locality point may overlap neighboring administrative coverage not tested here.
